name: sgr-defect-act-registry
description: Реестр дефектных актов СГР — внутренний продукт Dana Holding

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/config build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/domain build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/api build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/worker build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/config build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/domain build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/domain test && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database test
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/domain build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database generate && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database seed
